derivation.tower: tools/scans/align-tower.mjs + global-reg.mjs + finalize-tower.mjs (alignment) then tools/scans/build-tower.mjs (crop, fragment removal, chart re-atlas to one JPEG, meshoptimizer LODs, lantern-top infill, collider heightfield)
derivation.field: tools/scans/stadium-level.mjs + stadium-align.mjs (alignment) then tools/scans/build-stadium.mjs (field-only crop, flatten, re-atlas)
derivation.westStand: tools/scans/stand-probe.mjs (bowl section reach from the real authored scene) then tools/scans/build-stand.mjs (west-straight crop, fragment removal, clean rim line + trim of torn rim/press-box remnants; original source photo UV charts kept (tools/scans/stand-charts.mjs: no position weld across UV seams), used source texel regions re-packed at scale 1 into a 4096x2048 atlas (exact source texels, no colour/exposure edits), UV-aware meshoptimizer simplifyWithAttributes LODs that keep chart seams, far LOD embeds the same full-resolution atlas JPEG (no downsampling); reduced collider surface, seam profiles); transform = dkr-field.json. Fidelity: tools/scans/stand-fidelity.mjs

authoredInfill: ut-tower GLBs: flat grey lid closing the open scanned lantern top (material "UT Tower lantern lid (authored infill)")
ut-tower atlas: 7758 sky-blue bleed texels on the lantern rim desaturated

dkr-west-stand GLBs: 622 interior hole cells (1,244 triangles) surfaced at the hole-filled collider height - 0.03 m, separate untextured unlit material "DKR west stand authored infill (flat approximate capture tone)" (extras.authoredInfill), tone = median source texel of nearby captured faces

stadium-bowl.ts (generated, not in the GLB): rim parapet + roof cap from the clean rim line to the outer wall, and a press-box box fitted to the surviving scanned slab extents (dkr-west-stand.json sector.pressBox)
